_readme: Official depth register. Each row is one printed name in one printed slot, from a verbatim capture of a club's own depth-chart page. Columns are printed order only; no slot is designated a starter. Generated by tools/build_depth_register.py; do not edit by hand.

method.jersey_rule: a leading 1-2 digit number followed by a space is stripped into `jersey`; raw_cell keeps the printed text
method.shared_rule: two or more bracketed names in one cell = one printed slot, shared_slot=true
method.empty_rule: an empty cell that is followed by a filled cell in the same printed row = empty_gap=true
